title: Passwordless Login With Magic Link
description: Implement login without a password by issuing a one-use magic link, validating the callback token and creating a session after successful validation.
constraints: Do not introduce a real email provider in the mock planning slice.
Do not modify deployment, infrastructure or secret configuration.
Keep token generation, validation and UI feedback testable in isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can request a magic link from a login screen.
The system generates a one-use token.
The UI shows success and error feedback.
Minimal tests cover token generation, expiry, callback validation and UI feedback.
Infrastructure outside the declared scope is not modified.
